hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces a 4% dynamic LP fee computed per-swap from the pool's protocol fee tier, restricts all liquidity modifications to a single permanently locked full-range position held by a custodian, and maintains V3-compatible TWAP observations (tick cumulative and seconds-per-liquidity) across a 4096-slot ring buffer.
